# Limyè Foundation

> Empowering Communities. Building Pathways to Independence across Alabama (Tuscaloosa & Huntsville).

Limyè Foundation is a 501(c)(3) pending nonprofit organization providing vulnerable populations with essential pillars for stability: **Housing**, **Healthcare Transportation**, and **Nutritional Support**. By addressing interconnected social determinants of health, Limyè Foundation empowers veterans, seniors, SSI recipients, at-risk youth, and low-income families to achieve self-sufficiency and improved quality of life.

## Key Information
- **Legal Business Name**: Limyè Foundation
- **Associated Entity**: Porch Light Foundation
- **Founder & Executive Director**: Quincy Ruffin
- **Primary Locations**: Tuscaloosa & Huntsville, Alabama (Serving West Alabama & North Alabama)
- **Status**: 501(c)(3) Nonprofit (Filing Pending Approval)
- **Primary Domain**: https://limyefoundation.org
- **Primary Email**: info@limyefoundation.org / QRuffin@limyefoundation.org
- **24/7 Support Line & AI Assistant (Jamie)**: +1 (205) 300-9531
- **Direct Phone**: +1 (205) 393-7396

## Primary Capabilities & Services
- **Stable Housing Programs**: Safe, affordable supportive housing for veterans, seniors, SSI recipients, and unhoused individuals with wrap-around case management and life skills training.
- **Healthcare Transportation (NEMT)**: White-glove transportation removing mobility barriers for medical appointments, therapy, education, and employment.
- **Nutritional Support & Medically Tailored Meals**: Home-delivered customized nutrition and meal support for managing chronic conditions (e.g., diabetes, hypertension) and food insecurity.
- **24/7 Automated Navigation (Jamie)**: Multilingual AI assistant available 24/7 at (205) 300-9531 to assist with intake, program info, and human support routing.
